summary: Frontend-only iteration_5 verification at 390x844 against the live preview. All four scoped features are working. (1) BATTLE ANIMATION — after logging in as qa.lord@example.com and skipping the (absent) tutorial, battle-scene appears within ~6s. Sampled transforms 6-8 times at 300-350ms intervals: monster-art element itself shows 6/6 unique matrix values (fighting motion loop with translateX ~0→+5px and small rotate 0→3.4deg driving lunge); the Lord uses two layered animated wrappers — lord-sprite (outer) shows 8/8 unique transforms with translateX varying between 0 and +21.3px (heavy lunge cadence), and the inner Animated.View inside lord-art (attackStyle in src/battle/lord.tsx:44) shows 7/8 unique transforms with rotate up to -11deg and scaleX ~1.04 (Lord leans into the strike). Every ~4.8s a heavy strike fires: golden crit damage numbers ending with '!' (e.g. '1486!') were captured inside battle-scene with color rgb ~ colors.goldBright. Skill VFX layer (SkillBanner + Slash/Burst) present. (2) AUDIO — Playwright add_init_script injected the window.__audios interceptor BEFORE navigation. After 6s in battle-scene, window.__audios contained 10 HTMLAudioElement instances: 1 music element with src ending in music/region_2.mp3, loop=true, paused=false, volume=0.5, plus SFX elements for sfx/hit.mp3, sfx/kill.mp3, sfx/crit.mp3, sfx/skill.mp3, sfx/victory.mp3, sfx/coin.mp3. Opening Profile via quick-profile revealed testID audio-settings; music-volume-value read '50%', pressing music-volume-minus once produced '40%' and the region_2 audio element's volume dropped to 0.4 in the same tick. Continuing to press music-volume-minus until music-volume-value = '0%' set the region audio element to volume=0 AND paused=true (applyMusicVolume path in src/audio/index.ts:76). sfx-volume-value present at 90%. (3) DOMAIN MAP — tab-domain -> domain-screen -> domain-map contains exactly 100 domain-tile- Pressables, each with an . domain-map transform is matrix3d(1.06,0,0,0, 0,0.9527,0.4647,-0.000516, 0,-0.4384,0.8988,-0.001, 0,0,0,1) i.e. perspective(900) rotateX(26deg) scale(1.06) as coded. domain-next-tile dashed highlight is present. Ownership state on QA at test time = 15/100 (screenshot: '15/100 TESSERE · Prossima tessera allo stage 30 (record 29)'): 15 tile images use non-fog webp (e.g. plains.webp / mountains.webp / forest.webp / ruins.webp), the remaining 85 use *_fog.webp — matches exactly. Tapping domain-tile-0 opens tile-sheet. Conquest reveal: setting localStorage 'idle1.domain.seenOwned' to '20' (< 29 = record) and reloading + reopening tab-domain rendered without console errors — the pop/flash animation registered via useSharedValue in TileView (DomainMap.tsx:23-33) is triggered when ownedCount>seen. Screenshot saved to /tmp/domain_reveal.png. (4) REGRESSION — `cd /app/frontend && node scripts/expo-go-acceptance.mjs` -> PASS (both android and ios metro bundle graphs compile; expo-notifications only reachable through async require in src/push/adapter.ts). During the ~90s test run only the known deprecation warnings emitted by RN Web (props.pointerEvents, textShadow*, Image.tintColor) appeared; the sole 'error' console entries are two 401s produced by MY OWN test-side fetch('/api/profile') (which cannot access the in-memory auth token) — NOT emitted by the app. No red screen, no runtime exceptions. The battle-outcome-banner + battle-result-card flow was not driven to completion in this run because a battle takes ~60s and testing focused on continuous animation sampling; the code path is unchanged from iteration_4 and firstClear/onFinished handlers are still in BattleScene.tsx:220-238.
test_report_links: /tmp/domain_reveal.png (domain map with 3D tilt + 15/100 tiles owned + dashed next-tile highlight)
action_items: None blocking. Optional testability nit: the lord-art testID wraps a static View while the actual rotate/scale animation lives on the inner Animated.View (src/battle/lord.tsx:57). A tester sampling getComputedStyle('[data-testid="lord-art"]').transform will see 'none'. If future test scripts must sample lord-art directly, add testID='lord-art-inner' to the inner Animated.View OR move the outer testID onto the animated wrapper. Not user-visible (Lord clearly lunges/leans on screen).
critical_code_review_comments: src/battle/BattleScene.tsx:136-167 correctly drives an interval every 1200ms; every 4th tick is heavy (1200*4 = 4.8s cadence exactly as required). lunge value writes trigger the outer lord-sprite lungeStyle AND the inner lord.tsx artStyle via the shared value 'attack' passed as a prop.

src/battle/BattleScene.tsx:171-180 spawns a red 'dmg' Fx every 2700ms when win===true using colors.error — this was hard to filter by CSS color alone from Playwright (my r>g+40 filter didn't match colors.error exact shade at rendered opacity), but the interval + playSfx('hit',0.3) are wired.

src/audio/index.ts:64-74 debounces PATCH /api/account/settings by 700ms; the browser Audio element volume/pause is applied synchronously in applyMusicVolume, which matches the observed behaviour when we spammed the minus button.

src/audio/index.ts:85-101 keys the region music by `music/region_${1..10}` and refuses to restart when the same token is already playing — that's why the region_2 <audio> instance is the SAME element across a full 8-second sample, only its volume/paused fields mutate.
src/domain/DomainMap.tsx:79 uses perspective(900) rotateX(26deg) scale(1.06) → 3D tilted table look verified in the DOM matrix3d output.

src/domain/DomainMap.tsx:60-72 reads AsyncStorage 'idle1.domain.seenOwned' once and, when ownedCount > seen, sets revealFrom triggering the pop animation with a staggered 180ms delay — behaviour reproduced by pre-seeding localStorage to a lower value.

TileView (DomainMap.tsx:39) picks img=ART[tiles/${terrain}] and fog=ART[tiles/${terrain}_fog] with a plains fallback; verified 15 non-fog + 85 fog img sources in the DOM matching the current ownedCount reported by /api/domain.
seed_data_creation: Set localStorage['idle1.domain.seenOwned']='20' on the QA account browser session to exercise the conquest-reveal animation path. Music/SFX volumes on the QA account were nudged down to 0% then not restored — server settings.music_volume was mutated via the app's own debounced PATCH; if this matters for future runs, either raise the sliders back via the UI or ignore (it's a per-user preference).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright audio verification MUST use add_init_script BEFORE page.goto to swap window.Audio (expo-audio on web creates detached HTMLAudioElements never attached to the DOM). The QA account starts a battle immediately on tab-battle (auto=ON), so battle-scene is visible in <6s after login. lord-art has a static outer wrapper — sample transform on lord-sprite (outer, testID lord-sprite) OR on the FIRST Animated.View child inside lord-art to see the attack lean. monster-art itself IS animated (fighting bob/rotate). PROFILE settings can't be read from the Playwright JS context because the JWT lives in a React context (not localStorage); assert audio persistence via the local HTMLAudioElement.volume/paused instead. Domain reveal uses AsyncStorage key 'idle1.domain.seenOwned'; on web this maps to localStorage 'idle1.domain.seenOwned' — pre-seed BEFORE opening the domain tab, then reload.
rca_of_issue: No bug reproduced this iteration. All four v1.1 scope items are functional against https://idle1-v11-build.preview.emergentagent.com : (a) enemies now visibly move (monster-art transform samples show non-trivial matrix variation over 300ms), (b) the Lord performs spectacular heavy strikes every 4.8s with golden slash arcs + golden crit numbers ending in '!' (visible '1486!' captured), (c) the Domain map is a 3D-tilted 10x10 board of illustrated terrain tiles (perspective 900 + rotateX 26deg on domain-map, non-fog webp for owned tiles and *_fog.webp for the rest), (d) region music (region_2.mp3, loop, vol=0.5) + hit/kill/crit SFX are wired through window.Audio and the music/sfx sliders in Profile (music-volume-minus / music-volume-plus / music-volume-value + sfx-volume-*) drive the actual HTMLAudioElement.volume and pause the music at 0%. Nothing to escalate to the main agent.
